items.stem: In literary analysis, what does 'symbolism' mean?

options.text: When something stands for a larger idea beyond itself
options.rationale: Correct: a symbol represents a deeper idea.

options.text: When a text has no meaning at all
options.rationale: Symbolism adds meaning rather than removing it.

A spelling mistake made by the author
options.rationale: An error is not a literary symbol.

items.stem: What is the weakness of a response that only retells the plot?

options.text: It describes what happens but never analyses how or why
options.rationale: Correct: analysis must go beyond summary to meaning and craft.

options.text: It is always too short to mark
options.rationale: Length is not the core problem; lack of analysis is.
Retelling usually lacks quotation and analysis.

options.text: It focuses too much on the theme
options.rationale: Retelling typically neglects theme rather than overdoing it.
